arxiv-2108-00562.title: Recent Heavy-Flavor Results from STAR
arxiv-2108-00562.creator: Guannan Xie (for the STAR Collaboration)
arxiv-2108-00562.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Guannan Xie (for the STAR Collaboration). In these proceedings, we report on the production of various open heavy-flavor hadrons and quarkonia in Au+Au collisions at s NN = 200 ​ GeV \sqrt{s_{\rm{NN}}}\ =\ 200\ \textup{GeV} from the STAR experiment.

arxiv-2108-08676.title: Fine-Grained Element Identification in Complaint Text of Internet Fraud Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; November 1–5, 2021; Virtual Event, QLD, Australia Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and
arxiv-2108-08676.creator: Tong Liu 1 , Siyuan Wang 1 , Jingchao Fu 1 , Lei Chen 1 , Zhongyu Wei 1 , Yaqi Liu 2 , Heng Ye 2 , Liaosa Xu 2 , Weiqiang Wang 2 , Xuanjing Huang 1
arxiv-2108-08676.description: Abstract . Existing system dealing with online complaint provides a final decision without explanations. We propose to analyse the complaint text of internet fraud in a fine-grained manner. Considering the complaint text includes multiple clauses with various functions, we propose to identify the role of each clause and classify them into different types of fraud element.

arxiv-2204-00262.title: On the kinematic constraint in BFKL near threshold region
arxiv-2204-00262.creator: Hao-yu Liu, Xiao-hui Liu, Yu Shi, Du-xin Zheng, Jian Zhou
arxiv-2204-00262.description: Abstract We introduce a modified Balitskii-Fadin-Kuraev-Lipatov (BFKL) equation with the rapidity veto that originates from external kinematic constraint. Though it is a formally sub-leading power contribution, such kinematic effect becomes very important especially in the threshold region, where there is no sufficient phase space for the small x x evolution to be fully developed.

arxiv-2206-08053.title: JU_NLP at HinglishEval: Quality Evaluation of the Low-Resource Code-Mixed Hinglish Text
arxiv-2206-08053.creator: Prantik Guha, Rudra Dhar, Dipankar DasDepartment of Computer Science & Engineering, Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India
arxiv-2206-08053.description: Abstract In this paper we describe a system submitted to the INLG 2022 Generation Challenge (GenChal) on Quality Evaluation of the Low-Resource Synthetically Generated Code-Mixed Hinglish Text. We implement a Bi-LSTM-based neural network model to predict the Average rating score and Disagreement score of the synthetic Hinglish dataset.

arxiv-2209-11445.title: Another look at halfspace depth: Flag halfspaces with applications
arxiv-2209-11445.creator: Dušan Pokorný, Petra Laketa, Stanislav Nagy
arxiv-2209-11445.description: Abstract . The halfspace depth is a well studied tool of nonparametric statistics in multivariate spaces, naturally inducing a multivariate generalisation of quantiles. The halfspace depth of a point with respect to a measure is defined as the infimum mass of closed halfspaces that contain the given point.

arxiv-2305-00503.title: Characterising Clique Convergence for Locally Cyclic Graphs of Minimum Degree 𝜹 ≥ 𝟔 \boldsymbol{\delta\geq 6}
arxiv-2305-00503.creator: Anna M. Limbach and Martin Winter
arxiv-2305-00503.description: Abstract The clique graph k ​ G kG of a graph G G has as its vertices the cliques (maximal complete subgraphs) of G G , two of which are adjacent in k ​ G kG if they have non-empty intersection in G G .

arxiv-2407-03037.title: Seeing is Believing: Vision-driven Non-crash Functional Bug Detection for Mobile Apps Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 62232016, Grant 62072442, and Grant 62272445; in part by Youth Innovation Promotion Association Chinese Academ
arxiv-2407-03037.creator: Zhe Liu, Cheng Li, Chunyang Chen, Junjie Wang, Mengzhuo Chen, Boyu Wu
arxiv-2407-03037.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhe Liu, Cheng Li, Chunyang Chen, Junjie Wang, Mengzhuo Chen, Boyu Wu. Mobile app GUI (Graphical User Interface) pages now contain rich visual information, with the visual semantics of each page helping users understand the application logic. However, these complex visual and functional logic present new challenges to software testing. Existing automated GUI testing methods, constrained by the lack of reliable testing oracles, are limited to detecting crash bugs with obvious abnormal signals.

arxiv-2505-10823.title: From Embeddings to Accuracy: Comparing Foundation Models for Radiographic Classification
arxiv-2505-10823.creator: Xue Li, Jameson Merkow, Noel C. F. Codella, Alberto Santamaria-Pang, Naiteek Sangani, Alexander Ersoy, Christopher Burt, John W. Garrett, Richard J. Bruce , Joshua D. Warner, Tyler Bradshaw, Ivan Tarapov, Matthew P. Lungren, Alan B. McMillan University of Wisconsin–Madison, Madison, WI USA Microsoft
arxiv-2505-10823.description: Abstract Foundation models, pretrained on extensive datasets, have significantly advanced machine learning by providing robust and transferable embeddings applicable to various domains, including medical imaging diagnostics. This study evaluates the utility of embeddings derived from both general-purpose and medical domain-specific foundation models for training lightweight adapter models in multi-class radiography classification, focusing specifically on tube placement assessment and related findings.

arxiv-2509-00112.title: Statistical Mechanics of Paraparticles
arxiv-2509-00112.creator: Nupoor Thakur and Navinder Singh
arxiv-2509-00112.description: Abstract Quantum mechanics broadly classifies the particles into two categories: ( 1 ) (1) fermions and ( 2 ) (2) bosons. Fermions are half-integer spin particles, obeying Pauli’s exclusion principle and Fermi-Dirac statistics. Whereas bosons are integer spin particles, not obeying Pauli’s exclusion principle, and obeying Bose-Einstein statistics.

pmc-11342583.title: The role of reticulocyte hemoglobin equivalent on the evaluation of iron deficiency and iron deficiency anemia in pediatric cyanotic heart disease: a diagnostic study in Indonesia
pmc-11342583.creator: William Cheng, Piprim Basarah Yanuarso, Pustika Amalia Wahidiyat, Syarif Rohimi, Partini Pudjiastuti Trihono, Muzal Kadim, Dina Muktiarti
pmc-11342583.description: BackgroundIn light of prolonged hypoxia, children with cyanotic heart disase (CHD) are at a high risk of developing iron deficiency iron deficiency (ID) and iron deficiency anemia (IDA). Reticulocyte hemoglobin equivalent (Ret-He) is a novel and dependable indicator for assessing iron status. However, there has been no previous study regarding cut-off value in pediatric CHD group.

pmc-11407088.title: Disulfidptosis and ferroptosis related genes define the immune microenvironment and NUBPL serves as a potential biomarker for predicting prognosis and immunotherapy response in bladder cancer
pmc-11407088.creator: Xuezhou Zhang, Baoan Hong, Hongwei Li, Zhipeng Sun, Jiahui Zhao, Mingchuan Li, Dechao Wei, Yongxing Wang, Ning Zhang
pmc-11407088.description: BackgroundFerroptosis and disulfidptosis are regulatory forms of cell death that play an important role in tumorigenesis and progression. However, few biomarkers about disulfidptosis and ferroptosis related genes (DFRGs) have been developed to predict the prognosis of bladder cancer (BC).MethodsWe conducted a bioinformatics analysis using public BC datasets to examine the prognostic significance of differentially expressed DFRGs.

pmc-11497838.title: Insights into Ultrafast Relaxation Dynamics of Electronically Excited Furfural and 5-Methylfurfural
pmc-11497838.creator: Wenping Wu, Baihui Feng, Yuhuan Tian, Zhigang He, Dongyuan Yang, Guorong Wu, Xueming Yang
pmc-11497838.description: The ultrafast relaxation dynamics of furfural and 5-methylfurfural following excitation in the ultraviolet range is investigated using the femtosecond time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy method. Specifically, the pump wavelength-dependent decay dynamics of electronically excited furfural and 5-methylfurfural is discussed on the basis of a detailed analysis of our measured time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy spectra.

pmc-11523764.title: Does the high-intensity zone of lumbar intervertebral disc at magnetic resonance imaging have diagnostic value for discogenic low back pain? A meta-analysis
pmc-11523764.creator: Lei Yang, Long He, Hai Hu, Wenhao Li, Yongdong Yang, He Zhao, Jun Wang, Xing Yu
pmc-11523764.description: ObjectiveThe correlation between high-intensity zone (HIZ) of lumbar disc magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and discogenic low back pain (DLBP) is currently controversial, this study aimed to systematically evaluate the correlation between HIZ of lumbar disc MRI and positive discography, as well as its diagnostic value for DLBP.

pmc-11577354.title: Evidence of repeated zoonotic pathogen spillover events at ecological boundaries
pmc-11577354.creator: Antoine Filion, Mekala Sundaram, John Paul Schmidt, John M. Drake, Patrick R. Stephens
pmc-11577354.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Anthropogenic modifications to the landscape have altered several ecological processes worldwide, creating new ecological boundaries at the human/wildlife interface. Outbreaks of zoonotic pathogens often occur at these ecological boundaries, but the mechanisms behind new emergences remain drastically understudied.

pmc-13498965.title: A Large Secondary Umbilical Endometriosis (Villar's Nodule): A Case Report
pmc-13498965.creator: Babak Mamaghani, Mohsen Hasanzadeh, Amirmohammad Khodaei, Zeinab Shakibaee Fard
pmc-13498965.description: Umbilical endometriosis is a rare extrapelvic manifestation of endometriosis, presenting diagnostic and surgical challenges. We report a case of a 43‐year‐old woman with a history of two cesarean sections who presented with a progressively enlarging, painful umbilical mass associated with cyclical symptoms and bloody discharge.

pmc-13545205.title: Cloud attenuation estimation based on cloud particle sensor sonde observations for next-generation satellite communications
pmc-13545205.creator: Takahiro Ohno, Munehiro Matsui, Kiyohiko Itokawa, Tomohiro Tokuyasu, Kosuke Ito, Shoichi Shige, Tetsuya Takemi
pmc-13545205.description: Cloud attenuation due to cloud particles can be a critical issue for next-generation sub-terahertz (sub-THz), terahertz (THz), and free-space optical (FSO) satellite communications. Accurate estimation of cloud attenuation under various cloud conditions is essential for the design of satellite communication systems; accordingly, numerous cloud attenuation estimation models have been proposed.

pmc-13571945.title: Optic nerve infiltration in chronic lymphocytic leukemia treated with acalabrutinib monotherapy: A case report
pmc-13571945.creator: Fatma F. Shakarchi, Joseph A. Chacko, Joseph G. Chacko, Rangaswamy Govindarajan, Clive S. Zent, Sami H. Uwaydat
pmc-13571945.description: PurposeWe demonstrate the potential role of acalabrutinib, a second-generation selective Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor, as monotherapy in treating optic nerve infiltration by chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).ObservationsA 68-year-old male, initially diagnosed with CLL 13 years earlier, presented with a decrease in vision and intermittent floaters for 5 days.
